_comment: Phase 14 desk check of the second TVS2200DRVR listing (Board P r3 D5 stock gap). Only the extract and the hash of the downloaded PDF are kept; the PDF itself is not in the repository. No candidate record: a second record with the same MPN in component-tvs2200drvr would make the TI line's MPN route ambiguous.

project_rows_used: fact-c523793-vclamp-40a 28.0 V max (40 A 8/20 us, 27 C)
fact-c523793-vclamp-35a-125c 28.35 V max (35 A 8/20 us from VRWM, 125 C), used by rule-tvs-clamp-vs-absmax

source.document: TVSXX00DRVR flat-clamp surge protection device, V1.0 (PDF created 2026-06-29), 5 pages
source.authority: manufacturer document hosted by LCSC (the LCSC product-detail record links it)

extract.abs_max: Tj 150 C; Tstg -55..150 C; lead temperature 260 C 10 s
extract.pins: 1-3 GND, 4-6 VIN (protected line), exposed pad GND
extract.recommended: ambient -40..85 C; operating -40..125 C; ESD +/-8 kV contact, +/-15 kV air
extract.table_row_TVS2200DRVR_TA_25C: Vr 22 V; Vc 26.1 V; test current IT 1 mA; Ipp 60 A (8/20 us); Ppk 1120 W (8/20 us); IR 10 nA; forward Ipp 50 A / 80 W; IBR 18 mA; EFT 80 A; IF 500 mA; Cin 105 pF
extract.slew: keep input slew below 2.5 V/us at room temperature and 0.7 V/us at 125 C

matches: 2 x 2 mm 6-pin package with exposed pad, 0.65 mm pitch
gaps: The one clamp value (26.1 V) has no test current, no min/typ/max qualifier and no temperature; there is no counterpart to the 28.0 V (40 A, 27 C) or 28.35 V (35 A, 125 C) maxima the project bounds use.
Ipp 60 A x Vc 26.1 V = 1566 W, against the stated 1120 W; the pulse rows do not describe one pulse.
No breakdown-voltage limits, no 10/1000 us rating, and leakage only at 25 C.
Land pattern not compared with the corrected TI DRV0006A project land.
equivalence.status: BLOCKED: the Board P r3 5-set lot still depends on TI C523793 (4 in stock)
